textos.As opiniões divergem sobre a eficácia da: Opinions diverge on how well the narrative and its construction work. While most of those who recommend it praise the script and the dynamics of its twists, many among those who disapprove point out that the plot becomes nonsensical and exaggerated.
textos.O filme se arrasta de tal forma que cheg: The film drags so much that it makes you sleepy, and many scenes seem unnecessary, making the experience boring.
textos.A trama começa interessante, mas depois: The plot starts out interesting, but then gets lost in absurd twists and implausible situations, leaving the impression that the screenwriter lost control.
textos.Cheguei com uma expectativa enorme por c: I came in with huge expectations because of the Oscar and the hype, but the film delivered none of that, and it was quite disappointing.
textos.A mensagem sobre desigualdade social é i: The message about social inequality is interesting, but it is presented in such an obvious and forced way that it ends up losing depth.
textos.Não consegui me importar com nenhum dos: I could not care about any of the characters, they all struck me as strange or repulsive, and the story did not engage me.
textos.Achei as atuações forçadas e sem natural: I found the performances forced and unnatural, which contributed to my not believing the story.
textos.Muitas pessoas disseram que o filme foi: Many people said the film was overrated, since its fame created expectations that were not met, resulting in an experience that was merely good, not memorable.
textos.As figuras são mais símbolos de suas cla: The figures are more symbols of their classes than complex people, with insufficient psychological depth, which weakens the emotional connection.
textos.Furos de roteiro e falta de realismo: Plot holes and lack of realism
textos.Algumas situações foram consideradas iló: Some situations were considered illogical or forced, with questionable decisions and twists that seemed hardly believable, hurting immersion.
textos.A fotografia, os cenários e a direção de: The cinematography, the sets and the art direction were highly praised, especially the use of stairs and heights to represent social hierarchy.
textos.O desfecho foi considerado bizarro, anti: The ending was considered bizarre, anticlimactic or unsatisfying, with choices that did not please or that seemed hardly consistent with the rest.
textos.O início foi descrito como lento e monót: The beginning was described as slow and monotonous, but the film picks up intensity in the middle, although there are ups and downs that break the flow.
textos.Este grupo destaca como a obra expõe o a: This group highlights how the film exposes the chasm between classes, showing that the same event can be seen as a blessing or a disgrace depending on social position, and that the poorest are always the most harmed.
textos.Muitos elogiam a construção narrativa e: Many praise the narrative construction and the unexpected twists, which transform the story in surprising ways and keep the tension until the end.
textos.O grupo ressalta a maestria do diretor e: The group stresses the director's mastery in using visual language to reinforce the themes, such as the stairs and the vertical spaces that symbolize social hierarchy, as well as compositions full of metaphors.
textos.As atuações são amplamente elogiadas, co: The performances are widely praised, especially the actors' ability to convey complex emotions through a look alone.
textos.Muitos comentam sobre a brusca transição: Many comment on the abrupt transition from humor to suspense and horror, which can be shocking but contributes to the film's strength.
textos.O grupo admira a fotografia e o design d: The group admires the cinematography and the production design, especially the contrast between the rich family's modern, bright house and the poor family's dark, cramped basement.

textos.Dirigido por Bong Joon-ho e lançado em 2: Directed by Bong Joon-ho and released in 2019, the feature film Parasite combines comedy, drama and suspense in portraying the daily life of an unemployed family living in precarious conditions in a cramped basement. Glimpsing an opportunity, they devise a careful plan to gradually infiltrate the routine of a wealthy household, discovering that secrets and lies exact severe consequences.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica estrutura-: The cinematic experience is built on a measured opening cadence, relying on visual compositions full of spatial symbolism and on a tonal alternation that combines humor, drama and tension.
textos.No que tange à recepção, os três grupos: As for reception, the three groups address essentially the same elements of the production, disagreeing only in their verdict on its effectiveness. In the vast majority of ratings (~94%), nearly all highlight the impact of the social critique aimed at class inequality, while many praise the script and its surprising twists, and a significant share praises the direction for its ingenious use of visual symbolism. By contrast, in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~5%), for those who assess it from this middle perspective, a considerable number say that the high expectation generated reduced their enthusiasm, with some pointing to superficial or caricatured characters and a portion stressing plot holes and lack of realism. Finally, in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), from this negative standpoint, several criticize the excessively slow, drawn-out pace, while a smaller slice classifies the plot as exaggerated or nonsensical and a portion of them express frustration at the unmet expectation.
